approval_authority.token_digest: SHA-256(grant_material || approval_binding_digest || token_reference), computed by native authority
approval_authority.canonicalization: byte-wise sorted JSON object keys; order-independent

execution_ordering.crash_window_policy: crash after persist leaves approval consumed; user must approve a new plan (fail closed)
execution_ordering.atomic_consume: store mutex compare-and-consume; exactly one concurrent caller succeeds
